narr: Flash flooding occurred along Buckhorn Creek with impacted several sections along Buckhorn Road (LCR 44H). Numerous washouts were observed along Buckhorn Rd. from Ballard Rd to mile marker 30. An estimated 2-3 foot surge of water and debris was reported along Buckhorn Creek. In Denver, a landspout briefly formed in an open field near Denver International Airport. It did no damage.
ev: Flash flooding occurred along Buckhorn Creek.
